rfp_requirements.title: No Auto-Renewal
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must accept that the State will not agree to auto-renewal of any services, standard software maintenance, technical support, or service fees.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide a Next Generation VID (NGVID) to replace the Legacy VID
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must provide a new Vehicle Information Database (NGVID) to replace the current (Legacy) VID system.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional info on Security Engineering
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide additional information relative to the Security Engineering and Architecture control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe protective technologies for configuration verification
rfp_requirements.description: Describe processes and protective technologies to verify security configuration settings are maintained and to detect attempts to adversely impact CIA, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, FIM, and anti-malware software.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct Cloud Design per Agreed Service/Security Levels
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure design, configuration, and implementation of cloud-based applications, infrastructure and system interfaces are conducted in accordance with mutually agreed-upon service, security, and capacity-level expectations.

rfp_requirements.title: Fair and Open Process Exemption from Chapter 51 Certification
rfp_requirements.description: Contracts awarded pursuant to a fair and open process do not require a certification or disclosure of any solicitation or contribution of money, or pledge of contribution, including in-kind contributions.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish system development and acquisition security requirements
rfp_requirements.description: The organization establishes security requirements necessary to ensure that systems and application software programs developed by the organization or third-parties (e.g., vendors, contractors, etc.) perform as intended to maintain information confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and the pr

rfp_requirements.title: Describe Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe the SDLC including developers' access to production data, systems, and applications; version control tools used; promotion from development to production, etc.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement third-party risk management program
rfp_requirements.description: The organization implements processes and controls to ensure that risks associated with third-parties (e.g., vendors, contractors, business partners, etc.) providing information technology equipment, software, and/or services are minimized or avoided.

rfp_requirements.title: Satisfy Bidder Responsibility
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must meet the Bidder Responsibility requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe screening and background checks
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe the screening and background checks conducted for workforce (personnel, contractors, third-parties) with access to sensitive information (e.g., CJI, FTI, PCI).

rfp_requirements.title: Document Organizational Experience
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must document its Organizational Experience.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide organizational experience information
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder should include information on its organization, personnel, and experience, including references with contact names and telephone numbers evidencing qualifications and capabilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Location Information
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide Location information as required.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Organization Charts
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide Organization Charts.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit organization chart with key personnel
rfp_requirements.description: Include an organization chart with names showing management, supervisory and other key personnel (including Subcontractor personnel) to be assigned to the Contract, with labor category and title of each individual.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Resumes
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide resumes of key personnel.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit detailed resumes for all key personnel
rfp_requirements.description: Detailed resumes shall be submitted for all management, supervisory, and key personnel to be assigned to the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Demonstrate Experience with Contracts of Similar Size and Scope
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must demonstrate experience with contracts of similar size and scope.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide listing of contracts of similar size and scope
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder should provide a comprehensive listing of contracts of similar size and scope successfully completed, with two names and telephone numbers of contracting party individuals for each.

rfp_requirements.title: Demonstrate Financial Capability of the Bidder
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must demonstrate its financial capability.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide financial capability information
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder should provide sufficient financial information to enable the State to assess financial strength and creditworthiness and ability to undertake and complete the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Bidder may designate financial information as non-disclosable
rfp_requirements.description: A Bidder may designate specific financial information as not subject to disclosure when the Bidder has a good faith legal/factual basis for such assertion. The State reserves the right to determine whether to accept the assertion and will advise the Bidder.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete State-Supplied Price Sheet
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must complete the State-Supplied Price Sheet in accordance with the instructions.

rfp_requirements.title: Hold pricing firm through Contract issuance
rfp_requirements.description: Each Bidder is required to hold its pricing firm through the issuance of the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Use 'No Charge' correctly on Price Sheet
rfp_requirements.description: If an item is supplied free of charge, the Bidder must indicate 'No Charge' or $0.00 on the State-Supplied Price Sheet; other identifiers may result in the Quote being deemed non-responsive.

rfp_requirements.title: Participate in Oral Presentations
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must be prepared to participate in Oral Presentations if required.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Monthly QA Reports
rfp_requirements.description: Reports must be sent to the State monthly, including but not limited to Administrative Audits, Inspector Performance Audits, Equipment Audits, Call Center Stats Report, and Equipment Service Report.

rfp_requirements.title: Inspector Performance Audit contents
rfp_requirements.description: Inspector Performance Audit must include Date of Audit, Station Details, Auditor Details, Results Pass/Fail, and Administrative Action/Corrective Measures Taken.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Partial Report List (operational reports)
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must produce the full list of operational reports enumerated in Appendix 3.2A, including but not limited to: Emission Tests by Facility and Test Type, Heavy Duty Diesel Inspections, Failure Modes by Model Year (Gas/Diesel), PIF Inspector by Station, ERF No Match, Manual PIN Entries, Missi

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 8K vandal-resistant dome security cameras
rfp_requirements.description: Security cameras must be all-in-one vandal/tamper resistant 8K or better resolution color dome cameras with motorized zoom lens for indoor/outdoor applications.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide automatic imaging controls
rfp_requirements.description: Camera must provide automatic white balance, automatic exposure, gain control, electronic shutter, and backlight compensation.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide web server for camera viewing
rfp_requirements.description: Security system must incorporate a web server allowing for the viewing of the camera only.

rfp_requirements.title: Undercarriage inspection camera resolution/sensitivity
rfp_requirements.description: The undercarriage color cameras must have 8K or better resolution and 0.02 fc (0.2 lux) sensitivity.

rfp_requirements.title: Four-direction adjustable camera position
rfp_requirements.description: The camera position must have a four-direction adjustment, allowing for adjustment of pan, tilt, vertical height, and lens rotation.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide monitor per undercarriage camera
rfp_requirements.description: A monitor must be provided for each undercarriage inspection camera.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply security camera specs to Queue Webcam
rfp_requirements.description: Camera specifications described within Appendix 3.2E (Video Security System Specifications) must apply to the Queue Camera Public Viewing System.

rfp_requirements.title: Brake tester must be drive-on and stop type
rfp_requirements.description: The brake tester must be of the 'drive-on and stop' type and capable of quickly and accurately measuring and recording the brake effort of a motor vehicle's actual stopping conditions.

rfp_requirements.title: Programmable computer for brake tester
rfp_requirements.description: The brake tester must be equipped with a programmable computer.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide printout to failed motorists
rfp_requirements.description: Each motorist whose vehicle fails the brake inspection will be given a printout of the results.

rfp_requirements.title: Corrosion resistant plate finish
rfp_requirements.description: The entire surface of each wheel testing plate must be coated with corrosion resistant finish.

rfp_requirements.title: Modular plug-in electronic circuitry
rfp_requirements.description: Electronic circuitry must be of modular, plug in type construction, for ease of servicing.

rfp_requirements.title: Set State Audit Lockout on failure
rfp_requirements.description: If equipment fails, auditor must set the 'State Audit Lockout' in the workstation audit software and notify the Station Manager the workstation is out of service.

rfp_requirements.title: Request Station Manager arrange repairs
rfp_requirements.description: Auditor must request the Station Manager contact the appropriate repair technician and make arrangements for repair and/or replacement of the failed equipment.

rfp_requirements.title: Steps on OBD protocol communication failure
rfp_requirements.description: If an OBD protocol fails to communicate: reset the workstation's OBD module; scan verifier or vehicle with an OBD compliant scan tool to ensure normal functioning; repeat the audit to determine final outcome.

rfp_requirements.title: Workstation must include hardware/software for OBD access
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection workstation must include hardware and software necessary to access onboard computer systems on all OBD eligible vehicles, check for proper MIL command, determine readiness, and recover stored fault codes using SAE standardized link.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform visual check of OBD module and connectors
rfp_requirements.description: First part of OBD audit is a visual check of the OBD module, associated wiring, and diagnostic link connectors for broken casing, exposed wiring, bent pins, and tampering.

rfp_requirements.title: Login and select Opacity Meter from audit menu
rfp_requirements.description: To perform the opacity meter audit, the auditor must login to the workstation and select 'Opacity Meter' from the state audit menu; for stations without a workstation, the auditor shall complete data entry using the State management console.

rfp_requirements.title: Audit internal weather station for temperature and pressure
rfp_requirements.description: Opacity meter's internal weather station shall be tested for both temperature and barometric pressure accuracy using the auditor's weather station.

rfp_requirements.title: Inform Station Manager workstation can be used for official inspections on pass
rfp_requirements.description: If the equipment passes an audit, the auditor must inform the Station Manager that the workstation can be used for official inspections.

rfp_requirements.title: Configure verification tester scenarios
rfp_requirements.description: Configure verification tester via OBDII verification tester software; set up one scenario for each in-use protocol, including all three settings (Completed, Not Completed, Unsupported) for each of 11 monitors, randomly select a protocol, vary MIL status, and enter 1-6 emissions-related DTCs.

rfp_requirements.title: Compare scan results to auditor worksheet values
rfp_requirements.description: The status of the MIL and readiness monitors along with any retrieved DTCs must be compared to the values on the auditor's worksheet.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify Station Manager upon entering station
rfp_requirements.description: Auditor must contact and inform the Station Manager that an emissions equipment audit will be performed in accordance with the procedures and schedule.

rfp_requirements.title: Audit workstation in as-is condition via state audit menus
rfp_requirements.description: Audits must be performed on the workstation in its as-is/in-service condition through the state audit menus in the workstation software.

rfp_requirements.title: Populate audit information fields
rfp_requirements.description: Software must automatically populate information including Station Name; Start/End Date/Time; Workstation Cabinet Serial Number; Opacity Meter Serial Number; OBD Module Serial Number; OBD Module Firmware Version; Workstation ID; Station Manager or Recipient; DEP Representative; Status of workstation

rfp_requirements.title: Re-calibrate failed components and perform re-audit
rfp_requirements.description: Any component that fails an audit check must be re-calibrated (if applicable) by the repair technician, station manager or auditor, followed by a follow-up audit (re-audit) to ensure the equipment passes.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide required audit equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Auditor must have: audit laptop; 1997 or newer vehicle; OBD verification tester capable of simulating all in-use vehicle communications protocols; SAE-J1978/1939 compliant OBD scan tool; weather station and/or multi-meter with thermocouple attachment; sample vehicle registration barcodes; handheld o

rfp_requirements.title: Audit protocol applicable to CIFs, PIFs, PFFs, SIFs, BITs, and MITs
rfp_requirements.description: The audit protocol can be implemented on a regular or unscheduled basis at any facility that performs inspections (CIFs, PIFs, PFFs, SIFs, BITs, and MITs) to ensure emissions testing equipment meets criteria during enhanced emissions inspections.

rfp_requirements.title: Scan audit vehicle and record readiness/MIL/DTCs
rfp_requirements.description: For secondary method, scan the audit vehicle with an OBD compliant scan tool and record readiness, MIL status, and DTCs on the auditor's worksheet; then connect test system to vehicle and compare results.

rfp_requirements.title: Repair technician self-audit to satisfaction of manager and NJDEP
rfp_requirements.description: When auditor is unavailable, the repair technician must correct the problem and perform a self-audit in accordance with methods/tolerances set forth; must be completed to the satisfaction of the Station Manager and NJDEP.

rfp_requirements.title: Include required data elements in bus inspection process
rfp_requirements.description: The Bus inspection process shall include, but not be limited to, the listed data elements including credentials, identification, warning equipment, exterior, mirrors, underbody, fuel lines, underhood, tires, doors/steps, emergency exits, crash barriers, sunshield, instruments, wipers, horn, gear shi

rfp_requirements.title: Non-discrimination in hiring under N.J.S.A. 10:2-1
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not discriminate against any qualified and available person in hiring for performance of work under this contract by reason of race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, gender identity or expression, affectional or sexual orientation, or sex.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge $50/day discrimination penalty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor acknowledges that a $50.00 per person per day penalty may be deducted from the amount payable for each person discriminated against or intimidated in violation of the contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Post non-discrimination notices conspicuously
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor agrees to post in conspicuous places, available to employees and applicants for employment, notices provided by the contracting officer setting forth the provisions of the nondiscrimination clause.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify labor unions of non-discrimination commitments
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor/subcontractor will send a notice provided by the agency contracting officer to each labor union or workers' representative advising of the Contractor's commitments and will post copies conspicuously.

rfp_requirements.title: Revise testing procedures to ensure job-related testing
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor/subcontractor agrees to revise any testing procedures as necessary to assure that all personnel testing conforms with the principles of job-related testing established by NJ statutes/court decisions and applicable Federal law.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe employment change/termination procedures
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must describe procedures the organization follows to govern changes in employment (transfers, promotions, etc.) and/or termination of staff.

rfp_requirements.title: Log all OBD module requests and responses
rfp_requirements.description: The NGworkstation shall log all requests to and responses from the OBD module, labeled to distinguish requests from responses.

rfp_requirements.title: Ruggedize OBD module against drops
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall be ruggedized to protect itself from accidental drops.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform 45 drop tests (free fall, corner, edge)
rfp_requirements.description: Drop tests shall consist of 45 drops with equal numbers of free fall, corner, and edge drops.

rfp_requirements.title: Calculate OBD communications rate per vehicle category
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD communications rate shall be calculated independently for the three vehicle categories, excluding vehicles the State determines cannot communicate.

rfp_requirements.title: Support vehicles non-compliant with SAE
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall be able to communicate with vehicles that by design are currently known to be non-compliant with relevant SAE specifications.

rfp_requirements.title: Category 1 communications rate ≥ 99.9%
rfp_requirements.description: OBD eligible vehicles with GVWR ≤ 8,500 pounds shall have a communications rate ≥ 99.9%.

rfp_requirements.title: Category 2 communications rate ≥ 99.0%
rfp_requirements.description: OBD eligible vehicles with GVWR between 8,501 and 14,000 pounds shall have a communications rate ≥ 99.0%.

rfp_requirements.title: Category 3 communications rate ≥ 95%
rfp_requirements.description: OBD eligible vehicles with GVWR ≥ 14,001 pounds shall have a communications rate ≥ 95%.

rfp_requirements.title: Alternative hardware must share common core architecture
rfp_requirements.description: Alternative hardware for Central Inspection Facilities must be of a common core architecture with only specified modifications allowed.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit alternative hardware documentation for State approval
rfp_requirements.description: Any alternative proposed shall be documented by the NGcontractor and submitted to the State for approval.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD module primary power via rechargeable battery
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall be primarily self-powered by a rechargeable battery; 12 volt DLC source permitted only as secondary power.

rfp_requirements.title: Send OBD commands via SAE J2534
rfp_requirements.description: Individual OBD module commands shall be sent locally by the NGworkstation software by issuing SAE J2534 commands to the greatest extent possible.

rfp_requirements.title: Final OBD test design subject to State approval
rfp_requirements.description: The final OBD test design shall be subject to State approval.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure communications link with NGworkstation
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall provide a method of securing communications to NGworkstation via encryption or alternative security protocol subject to State approval.

rfp_requirements.title: No loss of communications under radio transmissions
rfp_requirements.description: No loss of communications while subjected to citizen's band, emergency band, and other radio transmissions.

rfp_requirements.title: Wireless communication between OBD module and NGworkstation
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall communicate with the NGworkstation wirelessly.

rfp_requirements.title: Minimum 75 feet wireless range
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall have a minimum range of 75 feet with a clear line of sight from transmitter to receiver.

rfp_requirements.title: Cable length between 1m and 5m
rfp_requirements.description: Minimum cable length shall be one meter and maximum shall be five meters; shortest included in standard package with option to purchase additional lengths.

rfp_requirements.title: Communications light shall blink during messaging
rfp_requirements.description: The communications light shall blink or flash to inform the operator as messages are sent and received.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide power indicator light
rfp_requirements.description: OBD module shall have an indicator light to inform operator the device has sufficient power to perform an OBD test.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide vehicle communication indicator light
rfp_requirements.description: OBD module shall have an indicator light to inform operator the device has established active communications with the vehicle.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform self-check on network layer
rfp_requirements.description: OBD module shall be able to perform a self-check on the network layer including ability to check both SAE J1962 and SAE J1939-13 connectors.

rfp_requirements.title: Unique electronic serial number for OBD module
rfp_requirements.description: OBD module shall have a unique electronic serial number made available to the NGworkstation for transmission to the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Firmware version available to NGworkstation
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall have a firmware version made available to the NGworkstation for transmission to the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Firmware updatable from NGworkstation
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD module shall have a method that allows the NGworkstation to update the firmware installed on the device.

rfp_requirements.title: Optional additional information - Personnel Security
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder may optionally provide any additional information relative to the Personnel Security (PS) control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Transition entire Program to NGSystem within 18 months
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall transition the entire Program from the legacy system to the NGSystem within 18 months of the Contract Effective Date.

rfp_requirements.title: Transition from Legacy VID to NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must transition from the legacy Vehicle Information Database (VID) to the Next Generation VID (NGVID).

rfp_requirements.title: Populate NGVID with legacy vehicle information prior to rollout
rfp_requirements.description: Prior to rollout of the NGWorkstations and software, the Contractor must populate the NGVID with legacy vehicle information and inspection data.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure inspectors capable of key inspection functions
rfp_requirements.description: Training and licensing are intended to ensure inspectors can perform emissions/opacity/mechanical inspections, understand the I/M program, identify emission components and tampering, and identify certified replacement parts on re-inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Identify certified replacement parts on re-inspection
rfp_requirements.description: Inspectors must be able to identify if certified replacement parts are utilized for any repairs upon re-inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Retrain and retest licensed inspectors
rfp_requirements.description: Licensed inspectors currently in good standing must be retrained and retested prior to renewal as required by N.J.S.A 39:8-52 or prior to implementation of the NGSystem.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: emission control device function, tampering, inspection
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of emission control device function, configuration, tampering and inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer employment to qualified current vendor personnel
rfp_requirements.description: To ensure uninterrupted transition, the Contractor should offer employment under the NGSystem to any qualified personnel currently employed with the current vendor prior to the Contract Effective Date.

NGWorkstation Monthly Audit Failure Rate
rfp_requirements.description: The NGWorkstation monthly audit failure rates must not exceed the benchmark audit failure rate.

Require HDDV centers to purchase NGWorkstations with integrated smoke meters

Deliver complete NGSystem at conclusion of Implementation Phase

rfp_requirements.title: Capability to collect and store inspection, MIT, and BIT data
rfp_requirements.description: The NGSystem must have the capability to collect and store all inspection data, roadside inspection (MIT) data, and bus inspection (BIT) data.

rfp_requirements.title: Capability to mask covert vehicle records and capture covert audit results
rfp_requirements.description: The NGSystem must have the capability to mask records for vehicles utilized by the State for covert inspections and for capturing/entering covert audit results to the NGVID in a timely manner.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide program-compliant OBD-only NGWorkstations to all PIFs/PFFs
Offer new NGWorkstations to all private diesel OBD facilities
Secure advance written SCM approval for opacity equipment prior to sale
Create and provide NGWorkstation User Manual
rfp_requirements.description: Prior to implementing the State ATP, Contractor must create and provide the State an electronic copy of the NGWorkstation User Manual explaining all aspects of usage.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure SCM approval for manual changes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must secure SCM written approval for all manual changes.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide, install and operate NGWorkstations with integrated smoke meters at CIFs
Provide each SIF with new NGWorkstations identical to CIFs plus covert software
Ensure SIF workstations never end-of-life
Install specialized/enhanced software identified via JAD sessions
Provide and install software for OBD and diesel smoke opacity inspections
Include State-operated MITs/BITs/CB inspectors in Supply, Maintenance and Repair Plan
Install new equipment in mobile inspection vehicles
Provide dedicated service/maintenance request mechanism for MITs/BITs/CB inspectors
Provide 10 NGWorkstations to State (MVC/DEP) for testing
Transaction fee must include program administration and equipment maintenance components
PIFs/PFFs shall pay inspection transaction fees
Bill and collect PIF/PFF fees directly
Complete in-process inspection before lockout takes effect
NGWorkstations modular on common platform for tests per N.J.A.C. 7:27-14,-15,7:27B-4,-5
Unit fully powered by one 120 VAC outlet
Include secure Wi-Fi capability at no less than 802.11g
Units capable of LDV, MDV, and HDV OBD inspections
Include ruggedized wireless bar code scanner with 75+ foot range
Include compatible printer operable from mobile generator or 12v inverter
Include NJDEP-certified diesel smoke opacity meter in CIF/SIF/BIT/MIT/CB units
Include OBD module with light-duty and heavy-duty interface connectors
Desktop units include monitor, keyboard, and mouse
Support air cards/mobile hot spots used by some PIFs/PFFs/SIFs/BITs/MITs
Firmware shall be most recent manufacturer version approved by State
Opacity testing equipment per N.J.A.C. 7:27B-4.6
Ensure NGWorkstations communicate with NGVID before, during, and after inspections
Support State option to issue State-paid air cards/mobile hotspots to MIT/BIT teams
Secure internet connections via HTTPS and State-authorized login credentials
Facilitate NGVID information utilization by NGWorkstations
Support 13 key information types in NGWorkstations
NGVID provides daily updates to NGWorkstations
Send Rules Engine updates from NGVID on daily or mutually agreed schedule
Allow manual on-site software/data updates to NGWorkstations

Work under State guidance to gather NGWorkstation Software requirements
Price NGWorkstation (PC based) for PIFs and PFFs
SCM approval required for system specification changes
rfp_requirements.description: Changes during system specification development require written SCM approval.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide robust online help application
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor software must include a robust online help application.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide page-level help
rfp_requirements.description: Online help must include help at the page level.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide data element-level help
rfp_requirements.description: Online help must include help at the data element level.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide process/topic-level help
rfp_requirements.description: Online help must include help at the process or topic level.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide help search capability
rfp_requirements.description: Help must include search at page, data element, process, or topic level.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide help print capability
rfp_requirements.description: Help must include print capability at page, data element, process, or topic level.

rfp_requirements.title: Enforce OBD system checks per schedule
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must require OBD system checks per the schedule in reference tables.

rfp_requirements.title: NGWorkstation communicates with NGVID for inspection history
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must communicate with NGVID each inspection to obtain vehicle/inspection history and related data.

rfp_requirements.title: NGVID draws data from MVC/OIT data system
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must draw registration status and inspection history (including legacy) from MVC/OIT data system.

rfp_requirements.title: Base VIR content on vehicle, parameters, rules
rfp_requirements.description: VIR content must be based on vehicle, inspection parameters, and associated rules.

rfp_requirements.title: Produce duplicate VIR on request
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must produce duplicate VIRs on request using NGVID data.

rfp_requirements.title: Include VIN decoder in all workstations
rfp_requirements.description: All workstations must include a VIN decoder for multiple vehicle classes.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide 10 alternate VIN decoder licenses
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide State with 10 alternate VIN decoder licenses for entire Contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Include auditor and maintenance operating modes
rfp_requirements.description: Software must include separate auditor and maintenance technician operating modes.

rfp_requirements.title: Audit mode capabilities
rfp_requirements.description: Audit mode must allow auditors special access and USB transfer of inspection, reference data and logs for QA/enforcement only.

rfp_requirements.title: Log audit/technician mode usage to NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: All auditor/technician mode use must be recorded and logs transferred to NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Commonality of NGWorkstation software
rfp_requirements.description: All NGWorkstation software must be tailored per primary use and driven by rules/reference tables.

rfp_requirements.title: Include training mode
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstations/software must include a training mode producing a training VIR.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not store/transmit training records
rfp_requirements.description: Training inspection records must not be stored on workstation or transmitted to NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Training mode restricts secured access
rfp_requirements.description: Training mode must not access secured workstation hardware/software areas.

rfp_requirements.title: Display training notice throughout inspection
rfp_requirements.description: Display must show training message throughout training mode inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Mark training VIRs and barcode
rfp_requirements.description: Training VIRs must be marked on face and in barcode as training.

rfp_requirements.title: Include diagnostic (scan tool) mode
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstations must include diagnostic mode usable as a garage scan tool.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement start-of-day data refresh
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstations must perform start-of-day data refresh on first NGVID contact each day.

rfp_requirements.title: Check lockouts at begin test and refresh
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstations must check NGVID lockouts at each begin-test and data refresh.

rfp_requirements.title: Set/clear lockouts via workstation and Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: Lockouts must be settable/clearable by authorized users from NGWorkstation and Management Console.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Facility license inactive/revoked/suspended
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when the facility license is inactive, revoked, or suspended.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Reference tables or Rules Engine data corrupted
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when reference tables or Rules Engine data set are corrupted.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Software configuration not current
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when the software configuration is not current.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Invalid NGVID transactions exceed maximum
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when invalid NGVID transactions exceed the maximum allowed.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Non-payment of transaction fees
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out upon non-payment of transaction fees.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: State workstation lockout
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when a State-issued workstation lockout is in effect.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Audit failure
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out upon audit failure.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: OBD module self-test failure
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out upon OBD module self-test failure.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: OBD testing lockout
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must support an OBD testing lockout.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Opacity testing lockout
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must support an opacity testing lockout.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Offline inspections exceed maximum
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when it exceeds the maximum number of offline inspections allowed.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout reason: Inspections without barcode scan exceed maximum
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must lock out when it exceeds the maximum number of inspections performed without a barcode scan.

rfp_requirements.title: Emissions test must be blind
rfp_requirements.description: Emissions test must be a blind process with no results displayed until final pass/fail or authorized abort.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide remote investigative access
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide remote access for limited authorized State personnel to download inspection data/logs.

rfp_requirements.title: Automated equipment audit and additional audit data entry
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must include automated equipment audit and support additional Audit Data entry per Section 4.17.5.

rfp_requirements.title: Support covert VIN designation
rfp_requirements.description: Must designate covert vehicles by VIN transparently to facility, handled identically to other vehicles.

rfp_requirements.title: On-demand covert vehicle management
rfp_requirements.description: Must allow on-demand designation/management of covert vehicles.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow multiple covert inspections daily
rfp_requirements.description: System must allow multiple daily covert initial and re-inspections without being apparent to inspectors.

rfp_requirements.title: Covert re-inspections reference initial failure
rfp_requirements.description: Covert re-inspections must always reference the initial failed inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Meet operating performance standards post-acceptance
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must meet listed operating performance standards after final SCM NGSystem acceptance.

rfp_requirements.title: Transmit complete Inspection records to NGSystem within 60 seconds
rfp_requirements.description: Complete Inspection records from NGWorkstations must transmit successfully and accurately to the NGSystem within 60 seconds during the principal operating period, excluding when inspection facilities have no Internet connection. Failure incurs $1 USD per record not transmitted within 60 seconds.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain OBD communications rate between NGWorkstation and vehicle
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain OBD communications rate between the NGWorkstation and the successful communication rates for the three GVRW categories. Failure incurs $5,000 USD for every percentage shortfall.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD Communications Rate for Vehicles ≤ 8,500 lbs GVWR
rfp_requirements.description: The OBD communications rate between the NGWorkstation and vehicles required to receive an OBD test must be >= 99.9% for vehicles with GVWR <= 8,500 pounds.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain All Inspection Data for Contract Term in Archive Database
rfp_requirements.description: The NGSystem must retain all inspection data (both historically migrated and currently generated records) and all related data for the Contract term in the NGVID archive database.

rfp_requirements.title: Transmit inspection records within 60 seconds
rfp_requirements.description: Complete inspection records must transmit to NGSystem within 60 seconds during principal hours (excluding connectivity loss).

rfp_requirements.title: Transmit to OIT/MVC on 1-minute intervals
rfp_requirements.description: Inspection records must transmit on 1-minute intervals 100% of the time during principal hours to OIT and MVC.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit production downtime during principal hours
rfp_requirements.description: Production downtime must not exceed 4 consecutive hours/event or 8 hours cumulative during principal hours.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit unscheduled non-principal downtime
rfp_requirements.description: Unscheduled non-principal downtime must not exceed 8 consecutive hours/event or 16 hours cumulative.

rfp_requirements.title: Average NGWorkstation response ≤5 seconds
rfp_requirements.description: Average NGWorkstation response time must be ≤5 seconds averaged over daily principal hours, measured per Section 4.15 Hours of Operation.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit UAT downtime
rfp_requirements.description: UAT downtime must not exceed 16 consecutive principal hours/event or 24 hours/month cumulative (excluding scheduled).

rfp_requirements.title: OBD communications rate ≥99.9% (≤8,500 lb)
rfp_requirements.description: OBD comms rate must be ≥99.9% for vehicles ≤8,500 lb GVWR.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD communications rate ≥99.0% (8,501–14,000 lb)
rfp_requirements.description: OBD comms rate must be ≥99.0% for GVWR 8,501–14,000 lb.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD communications rate ≥95.0% (≥14,001 lb)
rfp_requirements.description: OBD comms rate must be ≥95.0% for GVWR ≥14,001 lb.

rfp_requirements.title: Exclude problematic vehicles from OBD rate
rfp_requirements.description: Vehicles flagged problematic in NJ OBD Hardware Spec 12.7 must be excluded from OBD rate calculations.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain 3 years in NGVID transactional DB
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID transactional DB must retain inspection data online/real-time accessible for minimum 3 years.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain inspection data for Contract term in archive
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID archive DB must retain all historical and current inspection data for Contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Identify software configuration each NGVID contact
rfp_requirements.description: Each NGWorkstation-to-NGVID contact must identify current software configuration.

rfp_requirements.title: Keep historical rules/reference tables
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must retain historical versions of rules and reference tables.

rfp_requirements.title: Auto-update outdated NGWorkstations
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must automatically update outdated NGWorkstation configurations upon detection.

rfp_requirements.title: Lock out workstations not timely updated
rfp_requirements.description: Non-timely updated workstations must be locked out per reference tables.

rfp_requirements.title: Include currency procedures in Maintenance Plan (Section 4.22.3.8)
rfp_requirements.description: NGSystem Maintenance Plan (Section 4.22.3.8) must include software currency procedures and a proposed max lockout time period.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide two scheduled software updates annually
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide 2 scheduled software updates in year 1 and annually thereafter, in addition to bug/security routine updates.

rfp_requirements.title: Test security/OS/service pack updates per SLA
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must test and apply security updates, OS patches, and service packs per NGWorkstation SLA schedules.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure NGWorkstation against unauthorized access
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation hardware, software, and data must be designed to prevent unauthorized access/tampering.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide anti-virus/spyware/adware solution
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide a secure anti-virus/spyware/adware solution for NGWorkstations.

rfp_requirements.title: Prevent facility users from copying to/from NGWorkstation
rfp_requirements.description: Facility users must be prevented from installing/copying data or files to or from NGWorkstation.

rfp_requirements.title: Use barcode and PIN for inspector/auditor authentication
rfp_requirements.description: Authentication must use inspector/auditor license barcode plus PIN to tie identity to each inspection/audit.

rfp_requirements.title: Authentication distinguishes access levels
rfp_requirements.description: Authentication must distinguish between different user access levels (e.g., auditor vs inspector).

rfp_requirements.title: Retain records and verify data transmission
rfp_requirements.description: Each record and transmission must be retained for a State-determined period and verified in conjunction with administrative auditing.

rfp_requirements.title: Migrate legacy and new business rules to Rules Engine
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must migrate legacy rules and new business rules (e.g., Opacity results, MDD/HDD processes) to latest Corticon version or to a proposed alternative engine; migration must be straightforward and verifiable.

rfp_requirements.title: Legacy rules documentation in Appendix 3.4F
rfp_requirements.description: Appendix 3.4F provides additional documentation for the legacy rules, including data vocabulary, definition of inputs and outputs, and description of each rule within the three existing rule sets. Vocabulary and rules may be modified during design/development of NGSystem software.

rfp_requirements.title: Alternative Rules Engine capabilities
rfp_requirements.description: Any SCM-approved alternative Rules Engine solution must automatically determine rule conflicts, ambiguities, and incomplete rule sets.

rfp_requirements.title: Enable business users to construct/modify rules with grid-type entry
rfp_requirements.description: New Rules Engine must allow business users to construct and modify rules/rule sets with little to no Contractor assistance using a grid-type entry system usable by experienced Excel/Access users.

rfp_requirements.title: Rule creation software completeness/ambiguity checks
rfp_requirements.description: Rule creation software must include processes to check rules for completeness and ambiguity, identifying missing decision possibilities and ambiguous rules.

rfp_requirements.title: XML format for Rules Engine I/O
rfp_requirements.description: Data input and output transactions from the Rules Engine must be in XML format and kept in a log file on the workstation.

rfp_requirements.title: Rule set tracking capability with XML log
rfp_requirements.description: Rule sets must include a tracking capability that creates an XML log file documenting each decision made, either as part of output transactions or separate files.

rfp_requirements.title: Rule sets accessible from central server and loadable to NGWorkstations
rfp_requirements.description: Executable rule sets must be accessible from a central server and loadable to NGWorkstations to produce the same results.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure Begin Test communication with NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: At start of each inspection, NGWorkstation must first communicate with NGVID via secure connection to obtain vehicle/license information and collect applicable inspection results.

rfp_requirements.title: Send End Test results to NGVID and MVC/OIT
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must ensure final inspection data is sent back to NGVID to record End Test results and NGVID sends results to MVC/OIT Data System.

rfp_requirements.title: Support offline inspections for MIT/BIT/roadside
rfp_requirements.description: Process must be followed for all inspections when NGWorkstation is connected to NGVID except MIT/BIT/roadside diesel teams; when not connected, previous inspection data must be stored locally or previously scanned VIR used for re-inspections.

rfp_requirements.title: Store offline transactions and later transmit
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation must store transactions created while disconnected and transmit when contact with NGVID is re-established; must perform inspections/audits with or without connectivity to NGVID and/or MVC/OIT.

rfp_requirements.title: NGV-OLTP transactional database contents
rfp_requirements.description: The NGVID transactional database (NGV-OLTP) shall house vehicle data, inspection results, repair information, audit information, calibration information, I/M financial/transaction information, reference information, inspection rule information, and other information required to support the inspectio

rfp_requirements.title: Manage communications and data transfer among NGSystem components
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must manage communications and transfer of data, information, and software between NGWorkstations, State databases, and other NGSystem components, with communications protocols providing data exchange between inspection facilities, repair facilities, State users, and others.

rfp_requirements.title: NGV-ODS reporting structure database
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID reporting structure database NGV-ODS must retain inspection-related data in a format optimized to support standard reporting, data analysis, and program monitoring activities.

rfp_requirements.title: MVC-ODSR development and testing
rfp_requirements.description: The NGVID Operational Data Store Replica (MVC-ODSR), although hosted and maintained by State (MVC), is considered part of the NGVID data system; its new structures shall be developed and tested by the Contractor with State input.

rfp_requirements.title: Real-time hot backups of production databases
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must provide real-time hot backups of all production databases.

rfp_requirements.title: Program management functions
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must provide program management functions including the ability to manage inspectors, inspection facilities (CIFs, PIFs, PFFs, BITs, MITs, SIFs, etc.), ERTs, ERFs, provide reporting functions, provide triggers, manage covert vehicle information, enter Audit Data, manage lockouts, and perform o

rfp_requirements.title: Web interfaces for external users
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID must provide web interfaces used by external users to obtain information such as the school bus inspection report card, for the public to reprint VIRs, PIF/ERF location map, and for ERTs to enter repair data.

rfp_requirements.title: Supply or develop and test all NGVID components
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply or develop and test all NGVID components including communications, public web interfaces, industry web portals, Management Console, and all production/backup databases.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply security patches within six months
rfp_requirements.description: Software and OS security patches and updates must be applied within six months of release by the respective vendor.

rfp_requirements.title: Communications between NGWorkstations, NGVID, and State
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply/develop/test communications between NGWorkstations, NGVID, and the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Public facing web interfaces
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply/develop/test public facing web interfaces (CIF Wait Queue, School Bus Report Card, VIR reprint, and PIF/ERF location map).

rfp_requirements.title: Industry facing web portals
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply/develop/test industry facing web portals (ERT repair data entry).

rfp_requirements.title: Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply/develop/test the Management Console component of NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: All NGVID production and backup databases
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply/develop/test all NGVID production and backup databases.

rfp_requirements.title: Assurance of on-time NGVID development and efficient legacy transition
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide proven assurance that NGVID development and testing will proceed on time as planned and that transition from Legacy VID to NGVID is completed in the most efficient, effective, and practicable manner possible.

rfp_requirements.title: Document all applications, modules, software, and hardware components
rfp_requirements.description: During Implementation Phase, State and Contractor must review proposed solutions and requirements, and Contractor must document in detail all specific applications, modules, software components, and hardware components.

rfp_requirements.title: Use formal system development methodology
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must use a formal system development methodology including interviews with authorized State stakeholders and facilitated JAD sessions on-site or remote to gather, understand, and document all business and technical NGSystem requirements.

rfp_requirements.description: The NGSystem shall not suffer a "Major" security breach at any time during the Contract term.
