rfp_requirements.title: Support Specified NGVID-to-MVC/OIT Interfaces
rfp_requirements.description: Transactions from NGVID to MVC/OIT shall include Vehicle data request (RESTDEX), Inspection summary (RESTDEX), and Extract to MVC MVC-ODSR (Oracle replication).

rfp_requirements.title: Participate in NJ OIT System Architecture Review
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must participate in the NJ Office of Information Technology's System Architecture Review along with State Agency staff.

rfp_requirements.title: Meet OIT Policies and Standards
rfp_requirements.description: Proposed technologies and platform must meet the OIT Policy Library requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop Five External-Facing Web Interfaces
rfp_requirements.description: Five web interfaces shall be developed by the Contractor to allow external users to reprint a VIR, view School Bus Inspection Report Card, enter ERT repair data, view a PIF/ERF map, and view queue cameras.

rfp_requirements.title: Return Matching Results from Previous 180 Days Sorted Alphabetically
rfp_requirements.description: Once search criteria is entered, the website must return all matching results in the NGVID database related to school bus inspections in the previous 180 Calendar Days, sorted alphabetically by company name.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Required Fields in PIF/ERF Map
rfp_requirements.description: Required fields shall include Station Name, Address, City, Zip, Phone Number, Email, ERF License Number, PIF License Number (if applicable), A9 Specialization, L3 Specialization, Diesel Specialization, and Station Website.

rfp_requirements.title: Store source code in NJMVC-provided git repository
rfp_requirements.description: Source code shall be stored in a git repository on a platform provided by the NJMVC.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop and execute ATPs for NGSystem
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall develop and execute ATPs to confirm overall hardware and software functionality of the NGSystem.

rfp_requirements.title: Include required elements in each test script
rfp_requirements.description: Each test script shall include objective, parameter list of constraints, assumptions, necessary input data, and expected results for each step.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify SCM prior to performing acceptance testing
rfp_requirements.description: After SCM approval of test scripts, Contractor shall notify the SCM prior to performing any acceptance testing on NGWorkstations, NGVID, or other NGSystem components.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure sufficient NGVID data for ATP
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall ensure sufficient previous data is available on the NGVID to support both Contractor and State ATP; actual production data shall be copied to the test environment.

rfp_requirements.title: Demonstrate compliance with EPA, SAE J1667 and NJ OBD specs
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must demonstrate that all NGWorkstation equipment meets or exceeds EPA specifications (40 CFR §85.2231), SAE J1667 for opacity equipment, and NJ OBD hardware specifications in Appendix 3.4A.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify NGWorkstation inspection test accuracy
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must ensure the NGWorkstation accurately performs all required inspection tests on all vehicles, model years, weight ranges, and fuel types; generates and transmits correct pass/fail results per regulations and specifications.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify OBD interface across all vehicle types
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure the OBD interface correctly communicates with all required types of light, medium, and heavy-duty vehicles of all fuel types.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify NGVID functionality and requirements traceability
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify implemented functionality consistent with approved NGVID requirements, with all requirements satisfied via requirements traceability.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify NGVID usability
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID acceptance testing must verify usability.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify successful data conversion from Legacy VID to NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify consistently successful conversion of data from the Legacy VID to the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify data communication between NGWorkstations and NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify consistently successful communication and transfer of data to and from NGWorkstations and NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify data communication between NGVID and OIT
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify consistently successful communication and transfer of data to and from NGVID and OIT.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify seamless hardware/software interaction
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify seamless hardware and software interaction.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify accuracy and performance of system interfaces
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify accuracy and performance of system interfaces.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify system hardware/software/telecom performance
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify consistently successful system hardware, software, and telecommunications performance.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify end-to-end system testing
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify consistently successful results on full end-to-end system testing including NGWorkstations, NGVID, and OIT.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform integration testing
rfp_requirements.description: Successful integration testing to test compatibility and proper interaction of integrated code modules.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform system testing
rfp_requirements.description: Successful system testing to validate proper operation of all integrated NGVID functions and compliance with system requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform stress/load testing at 20,000/50,000 transactions per 8hr day
rfp_requirements.description: Successful stress and load testing simulating average of 20,000 transactions per 8-hour workday for typical operations and 50,000 transactions per 8-hour workday for stress testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Begin beta testing only upon SCM authorization
rfp_requirements.description: Following Contractor completion of successful acceptance testing, the SCM will authorize the Contractor to begin beta testing of the NGSystem per the approved ATP, with specific criteria agreed to by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Produce successful beta testing summary
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must work closely with State during beta testing and produce a successful beta testing summary proving all beta testing criteria are met; summary shall be submitted to SCM and incorporated as part of Final System Acceptance.

rfp_requirements.title: Software operating per approved Architecture and Design Specification
rfp_requirements.description: The State will accept qualitative performance of all software only when Contractor has satisfactorily demonstrated that software is operating in accordance with the approved Architecture and Design Specification, has deployed all components to the PROD environment, completed ATP and ATP results thro

rfp_requirements.title: Meet quantitative performance per approved NGSystem Requirements Specification
rfp_requirements.description: The satisfactory quantitative performance as specified in the approved NGSystem Requirements Specification must be met by the Contractor, as evidenced by written SCM approval.

rfp_requirements.title: NGVID Security and Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Plans SCM approval
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor NGVID Security Plan and Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans must be approved in writing by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Deposit custom developed source code with SCM in git repository
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall deliver to and deposit with the SCM any custom developed source code following successful beta testing. SCM will keep a copy in a safe and secure location. Contractor should update this deposited source code any time updates, improvements, or fixes are deployed. The deposited source

rfp_requirements.title: Develop and perform ATP on new NGWorkstations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall develop and perform an Acceptance Test Procedure including specific acceptance test scripts on new NGWorkstations prior to acceptance by the SCM, based on State-defined hardware, software, and functionality requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure written SCM approval before testing
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must secure written SCM approval of its testing plans, including NGVID and NGWorkstation ATP plan with detailed test scripts and a system beta testing plan, prior to the start of any testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct field beta testing of entire NGSystem
rfp_requirements.description: Field beta testing of the entire NGSystem must follow ATP testing, and successful completion is required.

rfp_requirements.title: Follow comprehensive end-to-end ATP
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall work cooperatively with State and IOC to follow a comprehensive ATP covering each component and perform end-to-end data communications and transmission testing between NGWorkstations, NGVID, and OIT/MVC data system.

rfp_requirements.title: Retrofit and transition BITs, CB, HDD and MITs to NGSystem
rfp_requirements.description: Retrofit and transition of the BITs, CB, HDD and MITs to the NGSystem.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop NGWorkstation Software
rfp_requirements.description: Include development of NGWorkstation Software as a major task.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop NGWorkstation Hardware
rfp_requirements.description: Include development of NGWorkstation Hardware as a major task.

rfp_requirements.title: NGWorkstation Software acceptance testing
rfp_requirements.description: Include NGWorkstation Software acceptance testing as a major task.

rfp_requirements.title: NGWorkstation hardware acceptance testing
rfp_requirements.description: Include NGWorkstation hardware acceptance testing as a major task.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain parallel operations of Legacy VID and NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: During transition both Legacy VID and NGVID must remain operational for a period determined by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Discontinue legacy barcode printing after legacy replacement
rfp_requirements.description: Once all legacy workstations are replaced and fully operational to State satisfaction, NGWorkstations must no longer print the legacy barcode.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain data integrity, security and content during migration
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain the integrity, security and content of all data at all times during migration, and extract State's legacy VID data and load it on NGVID PROD and UAT environments.

rfp_requirements.title: Load minimum 3 years data to NGV-OLTP and full history to NGV-ODS/MVC-ODSR
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must load no less than three years of data to the NGV-OLTP database and load the full history of legacy data into NGV-ODS and MVC-ODSR databases.

rfp_requirements.title: Determine exact NGVID data elements via JAD sessions
rfp_requirements.description: Exact data elements to be included in the NGVID shall be determined by mutual agreement between the Contractor and the State during JAD sessions, with system requirements and design discussions including additional data elements and changes to other data elements.

rfp_requirements.title: Present data conversion and migration plans in NGVID Transition Plan
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must present data conversion and migration plans as part of its NGVID Transition Plan.

rfp_requirements.title: Present plan to migrate Corticon Rules Engine
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must present, as part of the NGVID Transition Plan, its specific plan to migrate the current Corticon Rules Engine to the newest version, or focus on the proposed alternate Rules Engine.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide maintenance, repair, or replacement for NGSystem
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide maintenance, repair or replacement of all hardware, software and functionality of the NGSystem for the Contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide scheduled preventive maintenance for NGWorkstations and diesel opacity smoke meters
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must check operation and provide regularly scheduled preventive maintenance of NGWorkstations and maintain/repair/replace diesel opacity smoke meters at inspection facilities statewide.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain computer equipment and workstation software
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain and repair or replace computer equipment and workstations software as needed to maintain communication with the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain commercially reasonable NGVID maintenance schedule
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall maintain a commercially reasonable schedule and provide appropriate maintenance to the NGVID, including webpage adjustments and automated system monitoring as requested by SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Roll Out Release Level Changes Within 180 Days
rfp_requirements.description: Any release level changes (such as a new operating system release) must be discussed with the SCM and, if the SCM agrees and provides written approval, must be rolled out using an automated process within 180 days of issuance by the software manufacturer.

rfp_requirements.title: Automated Process for Release Level Change Rollout
rfp_requirements.description: Approved release level changes must be rolled out using an automated process (not manually) within 180 days of issuance by the software manufacturer.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide NGSystem training to authorized State staff
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide training for all components of the NGSystem to appropriately authorized State staff, designed for complete familiarization for State management, operational, technical and authorized personnel.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Management Console, NGWorkstations, and related tools in training program
rfp_requirements.description: Training program shall include proper use and functionality of the Management Console, NGWorkstations, ad hoc reporting tools, ITS, and other NGSystem tools, delivered as instructor-led hands-on classroom training.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide specialized training for up to four System Administrators per department
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide specialized training for up to four System Administrators for each department (MVC, DEP) regarding specialized report development and interface maintenance and operation.

rfp_requirements.title: Include required items in PI&E Plan
rfp_requirements.description: PI&E Plan must include preparation for NGSystem transition; public awareness for MDDV OBD and Diesel Smoke Opacity Testing; PIF/PFF retention and recruitment campaign with website and social media; at least six PIF/PFF seminars in different regions; establish Motorist Hotline; and keep program websi

rfp_requirements.title: Transfer NJ-specific components including web services and XML schemas
Execute complete transfer of daily NGVID data into Oracle database
Modify NGVID to accept data from future vendor upon SCM request
Provide Dashboard Overview
rfp_requirements.description: Management Console must include a Dashboard Overview.

rfp_requirements.title: Determine dashboard content during JAD sessions
rfp_requirements.description: Critical program operational information displayed on the Management Console dashboard is to be determined during the JAD sessions of the project — Contractor must participate in JAD sessions to define dashboard contents.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Inspection Data Retrieval
rfp_requirements.description: System must support Inspection Data Retrieval.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Inspection Data Retrieval capability
rfp_requirements.description: Provide capability to query inspections by VIN or other unique identifiers showing a summary of a vehicle's complete NJ inspection history, access details, and reprint individual VIRs.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Reference Table Management
rfp_requirements.description: System must support Reference Table Management.

rfp_requirements.title: Auto-deploy reference table/Rules Engine updates
rfp_requirements.description: NGVID shall automatically deploy reference table or Rules Engine updates to NGWorkstations based on a set implementation date and track updates.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Standard and Ad Hoc Reporting
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide Standard and Ad Hoc Reporting capabilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Issue Replacement, Collector, and New Car Dealer Inspection Stickers
rfp_requirements.description: System must support issuance of replacement, collector, and new car dealer inspection stickers.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide issuance/tracking of replacement, Collector, and new-car-dealer stickers
rfp_requirements.description: Management Console shall provide the ability for CIFs and SIFs to issue and track replacement stickers, Collector Vehicle stickers, and new car dealer stickers.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide sticker inventory control
rfp_requirements.description: Provide the capability to control the inventory of the various stickers issued by MVC to the centralized inspection facilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide CIF Queue Cameras and Wait Times
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide Centralized Inspection Facility (CIF) queue cameras and wait time information.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide CIF Queue Cameras interface and Wait Times display
rfp_requirements.description: Provide an interface to the CIF Queue Cameras and the ability to display the CIF Wait Times.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide SLA Tracking
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide SLA Tracking reports
rfp_requirements.description: Provide SLA Metric reports indicating conformance with established SLA metrics.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Access to Issue Tracking System
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide access to the Issue Tracking System.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide single sign-on access to Issue Tracking System
rfp_requirements.description: Provide authorized NJMVC and NJDEP personnel with direct access to the Issue Tracking System using a secure, single sign-on authentication method.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Document Repository
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide a Document Repository.

rfp_requirements.title: Integrate Document Repository with Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: May utilize existing commercial off the shelf document management product(s) to provide seamless integration of the Document Repository with the Management Console (e.g., single sign on).

rfp_requirements.title: Provide electronic versions with change/version control
rfp_requirements.description: Provide an electronic version of all documentation and employ change and version control processes to ensure documentation is kept current to the production release at all times.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure written SCM approval of Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: Secure written approval from the SCM upon completion of the Management Console; SCM holds final approval authority.

rfp_requirements.title: Include all training materials and documentation in repository
rfp_requirements.description: The Document Repository must include all training materials, plans, documentation, meeting overviews and minutes, Deliverables, and system documentation.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit repository/console access to SCM-approved users
rfp_requirements.description: Limit Document Repository and Management Console access to SCM approved, selected users.

rfp_requirements.title: Keep documents current within 5 Business Days
rfp_requirements.description: Keep all documents in the Document Repository updated and current; all updates must be made within five (5) Business Days after modifications/enhancements are made.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with NJ Open Public Records Act (N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1.1 et seq.)
rfp_requirements.description: Records received, retained, or transmitted under the Contract may constitute government records under N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1.1 et seq. and are the legal property of the State — Contractor must handle records in compliance with this statute.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow authorized users to load/view/edit documents securely
rfp_requirements.description: Once the Management Console is operational, the Document Repository shall allow authorized State and Contractor users to load documents and others to view and edit securely, with secure end-user access through the Management Console.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow metadata entry for documents
rfp_requirements.description: Allow State-approved end-users to enter metadata such as title, author description, document type or group, and role-based access restrictions.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow document uploads from approved computers
rfp_requirements.description: Allow upload of documents directly from any State approved and/or authorized Contractor staff computer.

rfp_requirements.title: Support any file format with agreed size limits
rfp_requirements.description: Support upload of any file format; file size restrictions may be determined by mutual agreement between State and Contractor prior to implementation.

rfp_requirements.title: Store documents in native and searchable PDF formats
rfp_requirements.description: Documents must be stored in their native formats and searchable PDF formats; provide search and download capability with fields corresponding to document metadata and content.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide User Management
rfp_requirements.description: Management Console must provide User Management functionality.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide User Management capability with roles
rfp_requirements.description: Provide capability to assign a limited number of users to manage user accounts and access to Management Console functions, allowing role-based access and multiple roles per user.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Administration of Inspectors, Auditors, ERTs, and Facilities
rfp_requirements.description: System must support administration of inspectors, auditors, emission repair technicians, inspection facilities, and emission repair facilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Administer inspectors, facilities, ERTs and ERFs
rfp_requirements.description: Provide capability to manage inspectors, inspection facilities and their NGWorkstations, including searching, modifying, assigning inspectors and workstations, assigning ERTs to ERFs, and locking/unlocking facilities and personnel.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide ERT Training Management
rfp_requirements.description: System must include Emission Repair Technician (ERT) training management.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide ERT Training Management capability
rfp_requirements.description: Provide capability to manage the Emission Repair Technician Program, capturing data such as technician identification, employer information, testing for ASE and State course, certification, and expiration dates.

rfp_requirements.title: Mail outreach materials upon certification if required
rfp_requirements.description: Upon successful certification/recertification, the Contractor may be required to physically mail the technician outreach materials to recognize their accomplishment.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Messaging Functionality
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide messaging functionality.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Messaging capability to inspection facilities
rfp_requirements.description: Enable sending messages to inspection facilities or groups by characteristics (location, type, etc.), with start/end dates allowing future transmission or transmission to offline facilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide NGWorkstation Management
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide NGWorkstation Management.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide NGWorkstation Management capability
rfp_requirements.description: Provide capability to query, create, update, and delete NGWorkstation data elements; assign NGWorkstations to facilities; create/remove lockouts; view lockout history.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Audit Administration and Audit Data
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide Audit Administration and Audit Data capabilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Audit Administration capability
rfp_requirements.description: Allow users to enter, track, review, and correct data from equipment, performance and record audits; provide audit reports; and allow the State to mask vehicles for covert audits.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Fraud Detection and Triggers
rfp_requirements.description: System must provide Fraud Detection and Triggers.

rfp_requirements.title: Handle Triggers and fraud detection methods
rfp_requirements.description: Management Console shall be capable of handling Triggers and other fraud detection methods; integrate the current Triggers into the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow alerts for specified conditions
rfp_requirements.description: The system shall allow alerts to be set up to inform State staff if specific conditions are met.

rfp_requirements.title: Include comments and entry-ID fields in watch list
rfp_requirements.description: Each watch-list entry must include a field for comments and a field for the ID of the person making the entry; both fields must be included in the inspection summary report/notification.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Covert Vehicle Administration
rfp_requirements.description: System must support Covert Vehicle Administration.

rfp_requirements.title: QA Plan: NGWorkstations operate properly, fraud mitigated
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure NGWorkstations operate properly and any risk of fraud is either mitigated or prevented in accordance with Contract terms.

rfp_requirements.title: QA Plan: NGVID operations accurate and secure
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure NGVID operations are accurate and secure.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain advance written SCM approval for modifications
rfp_requirements.description: All proposed modifications to design specifications or functional requirements (hardware, software, VID, and operational changes) must be approved in advance in writing by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish and maintain Issue Tracking System (ITS)
rfp_requirements.description: Establish and maintain a comprehensive Issue Tracking System to track system defects and issues from Implementation Phase through Post Operations Phase, covering software/hardware, NGVID, NGWorkstations, support operations, communications, and interfaces.

rfp_requirements.title: Ticketing software must support unique ticket numbers and attachments
rfp_requirements.description: The ticketing software must provide ability to assign unique ticket numbers, enter detailed diagnostic/troubleshooting information, attach related documents, and enter resolution notes.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe additional services (training, recruitment, QA) in Support Plan
rfp_requirements.description: Plan shall describe method for providing additional services such as training on NGWorkstations, assisting with private facility recruitment, and developing QA programs.

rfp_requirements.title: Dispatch FST when NGWorkstation not operational within 30 minutes
rfp_requirements.description: If CCR cannot restore NGWorkstation to operational status in under 30 minutes, dispatch a Field Service Technician to the station.

rfp_requirements.title: Deliver, set up NGWorkstations and provide end-user training
rfp_requirements.description: Deliver and set up NGWorkstation(s) and provide end-user training on the NGWorkstation as necessary for optimal PIFs/PFFs performance.

rfp_requirements.title: All inspectors must complete State training/licensing before inspections
rfp_requirements.description: All inspectors must complete the training and licensing process administered by the State before performing any authorized NJ State vehicle inspection. Significant program changes will require additional training and re-testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure PIFs/PFFs purchase new NGWorkstations at State-approved costs
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure all actively enrolled PIFs/PFFs purchase new NGWorkstations from the Contractor at State-approved purchase costs established by the State-Supplied Price Sheet.

rfp_requirements.title: NGWorkstation costs paid directly by PIF/PFF to Contractor
rfp_requirements.description: NGWorkstation costs and inspection transaction fees must be paid directly to the Contractor by each PIF/PFF and shall not be part of the Contract between State and Contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Limit NGWorkstation deposit to 25% of purchase price
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor may accept a deposit for the NGWorkstation not to exceed 25% of the full purchase price.

rfp_requirements.title: Assist current PIFs/PFFs transitioning to NGWorkstations
rfp_requirements.description: Assist all current PIFs/PFFs as necessary in transitioning over to the new NGWorkstations.

rfp_requirements.title: Make CIF video accessible through NGSystem Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: Video from all CIFs shall be accessible and viewable through the NGSystem's Management Console.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide accurate VPAT information
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must ensure any VPAT information it provides to the State regarding Software accessibility is accurate to a commercially reasonable standard.

rfp_requirements.title: Assign Custom Software Rights to the State
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor, Subcontractor, or third party shall assign to the State all right, title, and interest in any Custom Software and any copyright, treating it as a 'work made for hire'.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement third-party management controls
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must implement processes and controls to ensure third-party risks (vendors, contractors, business partners) are minimized or avoided.

rfp_requirements.title: Exclusions from Contractor IP infringement indemnity
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor has no obligation or liability for third-party IP claims arising from: (1) State's unauthorized combination/operation/use of supplied product with non-Contractor products, devices, or software; (2) State's unauthorized alteration/modification of supplied product; (3) Contractor's complian

rfp_requirements.title: COTS/Customized Software 90-day material conformance warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that COTS and Customized Software licensed to the State shall operate in all material respects as described in the Solicitation and/or technical documentation for 90 days after Acceptance.

rfp_requirements.title: COTS/Customized Software free of malicious code at delivery
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that at the time of delivery and installation, COTS or Customized Software shall be free of viruses, backdoors, worms, spyware, malware and other malicious code that would hamper performance, collect unlawful PII, or prevent performance.

rfp_requirements.title: Remedy for breach of COTS/Customized Software warranty
rfp_requirements.description: In the event of a warranty breach, the contractor shall correct product errors or, if unable to substantially correct in a commercially reasonable manner, the State may end its usage and recover license fees paid and any unused, prepaid technical support fees.

rfp_requirements.title: Custom Software 180-day material conformance warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that Custom Software Deliverables shall operate in all material respects as described in the applicable specification documentation for 180 days after Acceptance.

rfp_requirements.title: Custom Software free of malicious code at Acceptance
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that at time of Acceptance, Custom Software shall be free of viruses, backdoors, worms, spyware, malware and other malicious code that would hamper performance, collect unlawful PII, or prevent required performance.

rfp_requirements.title: Custom Software warranty does not limit breach-of-confidentiality obligations
rfp_requirements.description: Under no circumstances do the Custom Software warranty provisions limit the contractor's obligations in the event of a breach of confidentiality.

rfp_requirements.title: Remedy for breach of Custom Software warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Upon warranty breach, contractor shall correct Custom Software errors; if unable to substantially correct in a commercially reasonable manner, the State may recover a portion of fees paid (or, if still usable, recover a portion up to total charges) to reflect reduced value.

rfp_requirements.title: One-year Software-with-Hardware warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that all Software included with the Hardware shall perform substantially in accordance with specifications for one year from Acceptance, and that Software media will be free from material defects in materials and workmanship for one year from Acceptance.

rfp_requirements.title: Audit notice contents and standards
rfp_requirements.description: The audit notice shall reference specific audit provisions in the contractor's proposal or Standard Form Agreement, include copies of same, specify the means by which the contractor will conduct the audit, and require the audit to be conducted in accordance with generally accepted standards in the f

rfp_requirements.title: Provide and operate all hardware, software, network support
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must be responsible for the acquisition and operation of all hardware, software, and network support related to the services, including establishing, managing, and maintaining the environment.

rfp_requirements.title: Obtain State preapproval for media inquiries
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must obtain State preapproval before fielding media inquiries if Contractor specifically identifies the State or State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: IP indemnification exclusions - Contractor non-liability conditions
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor has no obligation or liability for third-party IP claims arising from: (1) State's unauthorized combination/operation/use with non-Contractor products; (2) State's unauthorized alteration/modification; (3) Contractor's compliance with State's designs/specs/instructions where Contractor ad

rfp_requirements.title: Describe cryptographic standards and technologies
rfp_requirements.description: Describe cryptographic standards and technologies employed to protect sensitive State of New Jersey data, including encryption/hashing algorithms, key management processes, hardware/software key storage, and key fragmentation.

rfp_requirements.title: Create Daily VID File After Inspection Processing
rfp_requirements.description: At the end of each day, after inspection processing is completed, program AIMSD105 must process the daily transaction records and create a VID file (lpmxaimp.vid.updt.dtl(+1)).

rfp_requirements.title: Remove Deprecated Vehicle Inspection Data Elements
rfp_requirements.description: No changes to the current Vehicle Inspection Information requirements, except Inspection Registration Suspension, Vin Source, Plate Source, and EEI Test Indicator will not be needed.

rfp_requirements.title: Send daily Inspector License file to Verizon
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must send a daily file to Verizon containing BLS Inspector License data using the MCI-INSP-REC layout.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Final Result and Overall Results on VIR
rfp_requirements.description: The VIR must display the FINAL RESULT, Overall Safety Results, Overall Emissions Result, and Credentials status.

rfp_requirements.title: Disclose Federal Emissions Warranty Coverage
rfp_requirements.description: VIR must disclose that vehicle manufacturers are required by federal law to provide federally certified vehicles with Emissions Warranties for at least 8 years or 80,000 miles (and up to 15 years/150,000 miles for some California certified vehicles).

rfp_requirements.title: Conform to AIMCA10 Lane Record layout (500 bytes)
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must conform to the AIMCA10 LANE RECORD (V.000505A) copybook layout with record length 500, including all sub-blocks (CA-ACTION-FLAG, CA-HEADER-BLOCK, CA-VEH-BLOCK, CA-REG-BLOCK, CA-INSPECTION-BLOCK, CA-TEST-AREA).

rfp_requirements.title: Support CA-MISMATCH-SWITCH valid values
rfp_requirements.description: CA-MISMATCH-SWITCH must accept ' ', 'B', 'N', '1', '2', '6' as 'no mismatch' and 'A', 'C', 'D', 'Y', '3', '4', '5', '7', '8', '9' as 'mismatch yes'.

rfp_requirements.title: Support CA-CRITICAL-DATEERROR-FLAG values
rfp_requirements.description: CA-CRITICAL-DATEERROR-FLAG must use ' ' or 'N' for no date error and 'Y' for date error yes.

rfp_requirements.title: Support CA-ICD-FLAG values
rfp_requirements.description: CA-ICD-FLAG must support 'Y' (Change MSO), 'F' (Foreign Title), and 'T' (Title Change Casual Sale).

rfp_requirements.title: Populate CA-INSPECTION-BLOCK fields
rfp_requirements.description: CA-INSPECTION-BLOCK must contain CA-INSP-SEQ-NUM (Facility ID + Julian date CCYYDDD + seconds since midnight), CA-MCI-TIN-NUM, CA-CERTIFICATION-CLASS, CA-BILLING-INDICATOR, and CA-MCI-TRANSACTION-DATE.

rfp_requirements.title: Support CA-PLATE-INPUT-SOURCE values B/M
rfp_requirements.description: CA-PLATE-INPUT-SOURCE must use 'B' for barcode and 'M' for manual entry.

rfp_requirements.title: Include CA-TRAN-SEQ-NUM transaction sequence number
rfp_requirements.description: CA-HEADER-BLOCK must include CA-TRAN-SEQ-NUM (PIC 9(11)) as transaction sequence number, and CA-FACILITY-NUM (PIC X(6)) as facility number within CA-FACILITY-ID.

rfp_requirements.title: Include CA-MCI-TRANSACTION-DATE field
rfp_requirements.description: CA-INSPECTION-BLOCK must include CA-MCI-TRANSACTION-DATE (PIC X(10)) with REDEFINES as CA-MCI-TRANS-DATE.

rfp_requirements.title: Conform to AIMWSVID VID record layout (150 bytes)
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must produce VID records using the AIMWSVID copybook layout with a record length of 150 bytes, including all defined fields (VID-PROCESS-CD, VID-VIN, VID-CORRECTED-VIN, VID-REG-PL-NO, VID-REG-EXP-DT, VID-REG-SUS-STA-CD, VID-VEH-MK, VID-VEH-MDL, VID-VEH-TY, VID-VEH-YR, VID-VEH-CLR, VID-VEH-FUE

rfp_requirements.title: Include VID inspection expiration date subfields
rfp_requirements.description: VID record must include VID-INSP-EXP-DT composed of VID-INSP-EXP-CCYY (CC + YY) and VID-INSP-EXP-MM subfields.

rfp_requirements.title: Support FAIL-Advisory Final Result Status
rfp_requirements.description: The VIR must support a 'FAIL-Advisory' final result status in addition to PASS/FAIL, as shown on the IDLE test VIR variant where FINAL RESULT is 'FAIL-Advisory' with overall safety, emissions, and credentials results still being reported.

rfp_requirements.title: Capture and Display Final Average Opacity Value
rfp_requirements.description: For Snap Opacity primary emission test, VIR must display the FINAL average value along with the applicable standard and PASS/FAIL result.

rfp_requirements.title: Conform to VID XML Schema namespace
rfp_requirements.description: XML messages must conform to the schema with targetNamespace 'http://etnj.appsolgrp.com/vid/xsd' with elementFormDefault='qualified' and must include common.xsd.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement AuditInformationType
rfp_requirements.description: Audit messages must include AuditInformationType containing AuditDateTime (xs:dateTime), WorkstationID, Facility ID, User ID, and AuditComments (xs:string).

rfp_requirements.title: Implement PrinterAuditResultsType
rfp_requirements.description: Printer audit results must include PlainPaperResults and ManualFeedResults, each of PassFailCodeType.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement OBDAuditResultsType
rfp_requirements.description: OBD audit results must include OverallResult, EquipmentVisualCheckResult, communication check, AccuracyCheckResult, RPM check, comm protocol, PCM module ID 1, PID count 1, PID 1C response, MIL commanded on, ReadinessResult elements (Misfire, Fuel control, Comprehensive, Catalyst, Heated catalyst, Ev

rfp_requirements.title: Implement DieselAuditResultsType
rfp_requirements.description: Diesel audit results must include OverallDieselResult, visual inspection, three sets of OpacityReading/OpacityStandard/OpacityCheckResult, WeatherStation temperature/RH/Barometer (reading, standard, check result), ExhaustTempCheckResult, and RPMDevice1–4 CheckResult.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement AuditRecordType
rfp_requirements.description: Each audit log file entry must be represented as AuditRecordType including AuditInformation, PrinterAuditResults, OBD results, and Diesel results.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement AuditRequest element extending BaseRequestType
rfp_requirements.description: AuditRequest must extend BaseRequestType and contain a list of AuditRecord elements (maxOccurs='unbounded').

rfp_requirements.title: OBDAuditResultsType must include CommCheckResult and RPMCheckResult
rfp_requirements.description: OBDAuditResultsType must include elements for CommCheck result ('Result of comm check') and RPM check ('Result of RPM check'), in addition to AccuracyCheckResult, as separate PassFailCodeType elements.

rfp_requirements.title: OBDAuditResultsType CommProtocol, PCMModuleID1, PIDCount1, PID1CResponse, MILCommandedOn elements
rfp_requirements.description: OBDAuditResultsType must include discrete elements for Comm protocol used, PCM module ID 1, PID count 1, PID 1C response, and MIL commanded on.

rfp_requirements.title: Appendices 3.2 A-J – Reporting, CIF Inspection Data, Historical Wait Times, Video Monitoring, Undercarriage Video Inspection, Web Cam, Building/Grounds, Lifts/Brakes/Air Compressors, State Audit Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must review and comply with Appendices 3.2 A (Reporting), 3.2 B (CIF Inspection Data), 3.2 C (Historical Wait Times and Inspection Data), 3.2 D (Video Monitoring System Specifications), 3.2 E (Undercarriage Video Inspection System Specifications), 3.2 F (Web Cam Snapshot View Specifications)

rfp_requirements.title: Appendices 3.4 A-F – OBD Hardware, Legacy OBD Flow, OBD Exclusion List, AAMVA Barcode Definitions, Vehicle Inspection Report, Rules Engine Specifications
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must comply with Appendices 3.4 A (OBD Hardware Specification), 3.4 B (Legacy OBD Flow Process), 3.4 C (OBD Exclusion List), 3.4 D (AAMVA Barcode Definitions), 3.4 E (Vehicle Inspection Report), and 3.4 F (Rules Engine Communications and Logic Specifications).

rfp_requirements.title: Capture Emissions Repair Data Fields on VIR
rfp_requirements.description: The VIR must include fields to capture Emissions Repair Data: Inspector name and ID (with barcode), Date of Repair, Repair Facility ID, Repair Technician ID, Repair Invoice Number, Confirmation #, and a Facility Stamp area.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Instruction to Present Failed VIR to NJ Certified Emissions Repair Facility
rfp_requirements.description: Fail Snap Opacity VIR and Fail Advisory Condition VIR must include the instruction: 'Please present to NJ Certified Emissions Repair Facility for completion.'

rfp_requirements.title: Display Pre-Defined OBD Failure Statements on VIR
rfp_requirements.description: A failing OBD VIR must display specific pre-defined statements in the Explanation section corresponding to the failed inspection item, exactly as shown in the provided chart.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Pre-Defined Text Exactly as Specified
rfp_requirements.description: Pre-defined text statements for OBD inspection results must display exactly as they appear in the chart.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Federal Emissions Warranty Explanation on Failed VIRs
rfp_requirements.description: The VIR explanation must inform motorists that vehicles failing the Emissions Inspection may be eligible for warranty coverage, noting the federal 8 years / 80,000 miles minimum and California-certified vehicle coverage up to 15 years / 150,000 miles, and referring the user to the vehicle owner's ma

rfp_requirements.title: Support Four VIR Output Types
rfp_requirements.description: The system must produce and display Pass OBD VIR, Pass Snap Opacity VIR, Pass Advisory Condition VIR, and Fail OBD VIR outputs.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Barcode on Failing VIRs
rfp_requirements.description: System must display a barcode on failing Vehicle Inspection Reports (VIRs) at the location and in the format specified in Appendix 3.4A.

rfp_requirements.title: OBDBulbCheck data element
rfp_requirements.description: Provide OBDBulbCheck as a String with values (P)ass/(F)ail.

rfp_requirements.title: Readiness monitors with inclusive OR across modules
rfp_requirements.description: Readiness Monitors shall be String values (R)eady, (X)Not Ready, (U)nsupported; use 'inclusive or' across modules to determine readiness state.

rfp_requirements.title: OBDCVN pad removal
rfp_requirements.description: OBDCVN shall have leading/trailing pad characters ($00) removed; length to be determined by Parsons & SGS.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD Log file must include required content
rfp_requirements.description: Log file must include date/time stamp, identifying vehicle data, a serial data log ('D5 data dump' per Vetronix ICD Appendix C), and a record delimiter.

rfp_requirements.title: Combine multi-module responses with Inclusive Or
rfp_requirements.description: When multiple OBD modules respond to a request, combine data using 'Inclusive Or', excluding RPM data.

rfp_requirements.title: Lockout OBDII Interface when reset cannot be acknowledged
rfp_requirements.description: If the module does not acknowledge reset by end of retry loop, prompt the inspector, set 'OBDII Interface Not Responding' lockout, and abandon/abort (PIF) or resume in another lane (CIF).

rfp_requirements.title: Record Null or 0 RPM after retry failure
rfp_requirements.description: If no RPM by end of loop, record Null if communications were lost or 0 if the module reports 0.

rfp_requirements.title: Identical Emission Clarification structure between CIF & PIF
rfp_requirements.description: The structure and content of Emission Clarification should be identical between CIF and PIF and designed by Parsons and SGS.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD Exclusion List appendix
rfp_requirements.description: Appendix 3.4C provides the OBD Exclusion List that must be incorporated into the inspection system.

rfp_requirements.title: Each AAMVA barcode field preceded by 3-position FID
rfp_requirements.description: Each field in the AAMVA barcode shall be preceded by a 3-position Field Identifier (FID) to allow interpretation without knowing precise structure.

rfp_requirements.title: AAMVA barcode begins with AAMVA header
rfp_requirements.description: The AAMVA barcode format shall begin with an AAMVA header.

rfp_requirements.title: Subfile Designator format
rfp_requirements.description: The Header shall be followed by a Subfile Designator for each Subfile with format xxiiiijjjj (xx = Subfile Type, iiii = offset from beginning of barcode to start of Subfile, jjjj = length of Subfile including terminator characters). Subfile starts at position iiii+1.

rfp_requirements.title: Future NJ registration barcode expansion
rfp_requirements.description: MVC is preparing upgrades to the NJ registration system that will include an expanded AAMVA-conformant barcode; the final layout will be provided when available. The system must be designed to accommodate this future barcode.

rfp_requirements.title: Support legacy registration barcode subfile IDs
rfp_requirements.description: System must parse legacy registration barcode subfiles including RG (Registration Plate Number - RAM field), VH (VIN - VAD field), IN (Inspection Expiration Date - EAD field), and ZJ (NJ1 Indicator ZJA, VIN Extension ZJB, Document Type ZJC).

rfp_requirements.title: PDF417 barcode on failing VIRs
rfp_requirements.description: A PDF417 Barcode shall display on failing VIRs.

rfp_requirements.title: Date/Time reflect start of inspection
rfp_requirements.description: The Date and Time in the Control Info section relate to the Start Date and Time of the inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Detail sections dependent on Overall Results
rfp_requirements.description: Each detail section is dependent on the result in the Overall Results section; failing emissions section appears when Overall Emissions Result = Fail, otherwise passing emissions section appears. Safety Conditions are printed only for items that FAIL the safety inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Failing VIRs have no page limit
rfp_requirements.description: Failing VIRs do not have a page limit for printing.

rfp_requirements.title: Emissions Repair Data form on emissions-failure VIRs
rfp_requirements.description: Emissions Failures shall print an Emissions Repair Data form at the end of the VIR; this form cannot be split between pages.

rfp_requirements.title: Calculated Date rule for 48-Hour Fail
rfp_requirements.description: If 48-Hour Fail and InspDate < InspComplianceDate, take InspComplianceDate minus 2 days and display end of following month; else display Compliance Date.

rfp_requirements.title: OBD Readiness result translation for VIR
rfp_requirements.description: For the OBD Readiness Result on the VIR, translate X's to F's (fails) and R's to P's (passes) for Readiness. E remains excluded.

rfp_requirements.title: Passing VIRs fit on one page
rfp_requirements.description: Passing VIRs shall fit on one page even if this cuts off part of the explanation section (pre-sized for passing VIRs).

rfp_requirements.title: Required VIR sample types
rfp_requirements.description: The following VIR types/samples shall be supported: Pass OBD VIR, Pass Snap Opacity VIR, Pass Advisory Condition VIR, and Fail OBD VIR (with EXPLANATION section).

rfp_requirements.title: Implement Rules Engine Inputs per Specification
rfp_requirements.description: Implement the Rules Engine with the specified App_Rules Inputs vocabulary (CurrInsp.tempHold, CurrInsp.error, CurrInsp.obdEmDetails, PrevInsp.obdEmDetails, CurrInsp.safetyDetails, PrevInsp.safetyDetails, CurrInsp.credentialsConditions, PrevInsp.credentialsConditions, CurrInsp.exceptionParms, PrevIns

rfp_requirements.title: Store All Legacy Data Elements for Historical Purposes
rfp_requirements.description: All data elements from the legacy NJAS and InspectionResults tables must be stored for historical purposes in the NGVID, although some will be deprecated.

rfp_requirements.title: Support CLVLDR Control Block with MLVLD Message Block and KLVLD Key Block
rfp_requirements.description: DEXML must support Control Block CLVLDR, which consists of Message Block MLVLD (with fields MLVLD_MATCH_DLN, MLVLD_MATCH_SSN, MLVLD_DOB_MATCH, MLVLD_DVR_DESEASE_STATUS, MLVLD_DVR_LIC_TY, MLVLD_DVR_LIC_EXP_DATE) and corresponding Key Block KLVLD (keyed on DLN, SSN, DOB).

rfp_requirements.title: Provide CRUD Access to Data from Disparate Sources
rfp_requirements.description: DEXML must provide CRUD access to data from disparate sources while concealing the data source and interface requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Use SLAs to Describe Client Permissions, Limits, and Fees
rfp_requirements.description: DEXML must use Service Level Agreements to describe permissions, limits and fees for each client.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement DEXML Service Methods doDexmlProcess and doDexmlDocumentProcess
rfp_requirements.description: DEXML must implement Method 1: public DexmlDocumentVO doDexmlProcess(DexmlDocumentVO dexmlDocumentVO) and Method 2: public String doDexmlDocumentProcess(String xmlRequestDocument). The second method is the same for both RPC/Encoded & Document/Literal. The DexmlDocumentVO represents both Request and

rfp_requirements.title: Use DexmlVersion Value of 1.0
rfp_requirements.description: The value for DexmlVersion in the DEXML XML document must be 1.0.

rfp_requirements.title: Use WS-Security to Validate Clients and Encrypt SOAP Messages
rfp_requirements.description: For Web Service clients, WS-Security must be used to validate clients and encrypt elements of the SOAP message.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement DEXML Value Object Field Structures
rfp_requirements.description: DEXML must implement defined VO field structures including DexmlDocumentVO, RequestDocumentHeaderVO, RequestDocumentVO, MsgBlockVO, KeyInfoVO, KeyValuePairsVO, FieldDataVO, RelativeKeyVO (not used now), UpdateRequestDocumentVO, UMBlockVO, UMBlockUpdateDataVO, ResponseDocumentVO, ResultInfoVO, MBlock

rfp_requirements.title: Expose DEXML WSDL in RPC/Encoded and Document/Literal Styles
rfp_requirements.description: The DEXML Web Service must expose WSDLs in both RPC/Encoded and Document/Literal styles at the specified URLs: https://emvc.state.nj.us/MVC_DEXML_WS/services/DEXMLBusinessSB?wsdl and https://emvc.state.nj.us/MVC_DEXML_WS/services/DEXMLBusinessSBDocLiteral?wsdl, with corresponding EndPoint URLs.

rfp_requirements.title: Restrict RMI-IIOP Interface to MyMVC Applications on MVC Server Stack
rfp_requirements.description: Only MyMVC applications running on the MVC server stack may use the RMI-IIOP interface.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide RefId (Control Block Name)
rfp_requirements.description: RefId is the Control Block name and a value is required in RequestDocument.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide EndUserId (Desktop User Id)
rfp_requirements.description: EndUserId is the Desktop User Id and a value is required in the request header.

rfp_requirements.title: Return StatusCode 1000 on Successful Response
rfp_requirements.description: A value of 1000 for StatusCode indicates success in getting a response.

rfp_requirements.title: Generate Self-Signed X.509 Certificate for GSN DEXML Key-Store
rfp_requirements.description: A self-signed X.509 certificate with public and private keys must be generated and added to the DEXML key-store on brick21/njapps3 for GSN clients.

rfp_requirements.title: Distribute DEXML Public Key to Pre-Authorized GSN Clients
rfp_requirements.description: The DEXML public key must be sent to all pre-authorized GSN clients.

rfp_requirements.title: Generate CA-Signed X.509 Certificate for Internet DEXML Key-Store
rfp_requirements.description: An X.509 certificate signed by a CA must be generated and added to the DEXML key-store on brick21/njapps1 for Internet clients.

rfp_requirements.title: Reset rulesheets run even if ruleset is terminated
rfp_requirements.description: ResetSoftwareVersion_Null, ResetOldStkr_Null, ResetPrevIED_Null, and ResetPrevInspDate_Null must reset attributes back to null if they were changed — and must run even if the ruleset has been terminated.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - Reset rules post-termination

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate inspection when mvcRegCode invalid for IM
rfp_requirements.description: Terminate the inspection if the mvcRegCode is not valid for an IM inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Initialize BeginTestCycle Ruleset Defaults
rfp_requirements.description: CycleInitialize rule sheet must add a TempHold entity, set rules version, default null inspExtentCode to F, omni2Indicator to N, inspDate to today, commercialIndicator to N, softwareVersion to zero-length string, transportIndicator to N, mvcRegCode to 0, vehicleGVWR to 0, and terminate if testRecord

rfp_requirements.title: ResetSoftwareVersion_Null runs regardless of inspExtentCode
rfp_requirements.description: Run ResetSoftwareVersion_Null regardless of the inspExtentCode value.

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate if mvcRegCode Invalid for IM Inspection
rfp_requirements.description: SetVehicleCategory_IM_v5a must run only for IM inspProgramType and terminate if mvcRegCode is not valid for IM inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Stationary Two-Stage Air Compressor specifications and replacement parts
rfp_requirements.description: Specifications and replacement parts list for Campbell Hausfeld Stationary Two-Stage Air Compressors (models CI050080HA through EX8404), including 5 HP (1725 RPM) and 7.5 HP (3450 RPM) electric motors with a service factor of 1.15, flow rate per ASME power test code. Overall dimensions: 32.5" width,

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Ingersoll-Rand factors for confidentiality/trade secret claims
rfp_requirements.description: If Company requests an exemption based upon confidential/proprietary information and trade secrets, Company must indicate: (1) extent to which information is known outside the owner's business; (2) extent known by employees and others; (3) extent of measures to guard secrecy; (4) value to the firm a

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Bid Solicitation # and 'For' subject on Questionnaire cover
rfp_requirements.description: The Questionnaire cover page requires entry of the Bid Solicitation # and the 'For:' subject of the engagement.

rfp_requirements.title: cycleStartDate adjustment example and >4 year future sticker rule
rfp_requirements.description: Example: a vehicle with a 4/2005 sticker presented in 6/2010 will have the cycleStartDate set to 4/2010. A vehicle with a sticker date more than four years in the future is in error and will follow the same rule.

rfp_requirements.title: Handle vehicles with sticker 2-4 years in future
rfp_requirements.description: A vehicle with a sticker date between two and four years in the future (new car dealer sticker) retains the same month but is adjusted to the current cycle; these vehicles are not due for inspection and lose their four-year cycle.

rfp_requirements.title: cycleStartDate determination for on-cycle on-time, off-cycle future, and on-cycle late vehicles
rfp_requirements.description: For an on-cycle, on-time vehicle, cycleStartDate is the sticker date. For an off-cycle, future vehicle, it is the sticker date minus one cycle (marking the nominal month the vehicle passed inspection; example: a 10/2010 sticker presented in 2009 yields cycleStartDate 10/31/2008). For an on-cycle, la

rfp_requirements.title: Set em dates when bus em not done
rfp_requirements.description: For bus with CurrInsp.overallEmResult='N', set CurrInsp.emComplianceDate and CurrInsp.emExpirationDate based on whether Temp.aaString='nullPrevEmDate' or not.

rfp_requirements.title: Set em compliance/expiration dates on bus em pass
rfp_requirements.description: For bus with overallEmResult a pass, set CurrInsp.emComplianceDate and CurrInsp.emExpirationDate to aaNewExpirationDate + 6 months.

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety compliance date for bus failed with no previous
rfp_requirements.description: For bus with Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=F and safety fail, set safetyComplianceDate based on overallSafetyResult. Treat 'F' and '4' like '3' and 'S'.

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety compliance date for bus failed with previous
rfp_requirements.description: For bus with Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=T and safety fail, set safetyComplianceDate based on CurrInsp.overallSafetyResult and PrevInsp.overallSafetyResult. Treat 'F' and '4' like '3' and 'S'.

rfp_requirements.title: Cap em compliance date at max compliance date for cycle test
rfp_requirements.description: For em fail where CurrInsp.emComplianceDate > aaAddOffsetCycle and inspModeCode='C', set CurrInsp.emComplianceDate to aaAddOffsetCycle.

rfp_requirements.title: Set em compliance date on em fail with no previous
rfp_requirements.description: When overallEmResult is not a pass and Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=F, set emComplianceDate based on overallEmResult.

rfp_requirements.title: Set em expiration date on em fail
rfp_requirements.description: When overallEmResult is not a pass, set CurrInsp.emExpirationDate based on the current inspModeCode (cycle/off-cycle).

rfp_requirements.title: Set em compliance date on em fail with previous
rfp_requirements.description: When overallEmResult is not a pass and Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=T, set emComplianceDate based on inspModeCode, overallEmResult, PrevInsp.overallEmResult, and Temp.aaOffset.

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate ruleset if InspExpirationDateCycle invalid
rfp_requirements.description: InspExpirationDateCycle must be valid or the ruleset will terminate.

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate ruleset on invalid or null required attributes
rfp_requirements.description: Certain attributes must have valid non-null values; if they do not, the rulesheet will terminate the ruleset.

rfp_requirements.title: Set reference dates for failures
rfp_requirements.description: Set reference dates for failures based on offset.

rfp_requirements.title: Set CurrInsp.overallEmResult
rfp_requirements.description: The system must set CurrInsp.overallEmResult based on lowest priority in the emission collection.

rfp_requirements.title: Set CurrInsp.overallResult
rfp_requirements.description: Set CurrInsp.overallResult based on overallCredentialsResult, overallSafetyResult, and overallEmResult.

rfp_requirements.title: Set CurrInsp.overallSafetyResult
rfp_requirements.description: The system must set CurrInsp.overallSafetyResult based on the safety collection priorities.

rfp_requirements.title: Cap safety compliance date at max compliance date for cycle test
rfp_requirements.description: For safety fail where CurrInsp.safetyComplianceDate > aaAddOffsetCycle and inspModeCode='C', set CurrInsp.safetyComplianceDate to aaAddOffsetCycle.

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety expiration date on safety fail
rfp_requirements.description: When overallSafetyResult is not a pass, set CurrInsp.safetyExpirationDate based on the current inspModeCode (cycle/off-cycle).

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety compliance/expiration dates on safety pass
rfp_requirements.description: When overallSafetyResult is a pass, set CurrInsp.safetyComplianceDate and CurrInsp.safetyExpirationDate to aaNewExpirationDate.

rfp_requirements.title: Set priority for each safety result
rfp_requirements.description: The system must set a priority for each safety result.

rfp_requirements.title: Create EmResult entity for each valid Em result
rfp_requirements.description: The system must create an EmResult entity for each valid emissions result.

rfp_requirements.title: Set aaNewExpirationDate and offset
rfp_requirements.description: Set aaNewExpirationDate based on inspExpirationDateCycle and set an offset value based on inspProgramType; offset is used to calculate compliance dates for failures.

rfp_requirements.title: Create SafetyResult entity for each valid safety result
rfp_requirements.description: The system must create a SafetyResult entity for each valid safety result.

rfp_requirements.title: Set em compliance/expiration dates on non-bus em pass
rfp_requirements.description: For non-bus with overallEmResult a pass, set CurrInsp.emComplianceDate and CurrInsp.emExpirationDate to aaNewExpirationDate.

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety compliance date for non-bus failed with no previous
rfp_requirements.description: For non-bus with Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=F and overallSafetyResult not a pass, set safetyComplianceDate based on inspModeCode, overallSafetyResult, and Temp.aaOffset. Treat '3' and 'S' like 'F' and '4'.

rfp_requirements.title: Set safety compliance date for non-bus failed with previous
rfp_requirements.description: For non-bus with Temp.aaUsePrevInsp=T and safety fail, set safetyComplianceDate based on inspModeCode, overallSafetyResult, PrevInsp.overallSafetyResult, and Temp.aaOffset. Treat '3' and 'S' like 'F' and '4'.

rfp_requirements.title: Use VehicleCategory to Determine Cycle Length
rfp_requirements.description: VehicleCategory must be used to determine cycle length (6 mos, 12 mos, 24 mos) and whether a vehicle gets a safety inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Use Correct CurrInsp.post Values (Info/Warning/Violation)
rfp_requirements.description: CurrInsp.post commands must have values of Info (normal rules), Warning (valid but incorrect data, allowing inspector retry), or Violation (invalid combinations indicating software problem, terminating inspection).

rfp_requirements.title: Warning Allows Inspector Retry; Violation Terminates Inspection
rfp_requirements.description: When valid-but-incorrect data is encountered (e.g., a vehicle configuration cannot be tested at the current facility), Warning must be used and the Inspector must be given the option to correct the data and try again. When an invalid combination indicates a software problem, Violation must be used a

rfp_requirements.title: Use errorLevel and errorDetails for Software Action and Inspector Display
rfp_requirements.description: The errorLevel attribute must be usable by the software to determine the action to be taken, and errorDetails must be displayable on the screen to provide information to the inspector and troubleshooter.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Vendor name and principal place of business in NDA
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor must populate the blank fields in the NDA preamble identifying the Vendor's legal name and principal place of business address.

rfp_requirements.title: Store Audit Data on NGVID
rfp_requirements.description: Audit data, which is not stored on the legacy VID, must be stored on the NGVID.

rfp_requirements.title: Track and Log NGVID Errors and System Issues
rfp_requirements.description: The NGVID must track and log any errors or system issues to aid in the resolution of NGVID-specific issues.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain Database Activity/Change Log
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain a database change (activity) log to support recovery, rollback, and other database management and maintenance activities.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain Workstation Transaction Logs
rfp_requirements.description: Workstation transaction logs must be kept for statistical and troubleshooting purposes.

rfp_requirements.title: Remove lift assembly from canister for visual inspection
rfp_requirements.description: During annual preventive maintenance, remove the lift assembly from the canister for visual inspection.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor to maintain lifts and air compressors at SIFs
rfp_requirements.description: The contractor will be responsible to maintain the pneumatic lifts along with the air compressors used by the current lifts at the Specialty Inspection Facilities (SIF).
rfp_requirements.section: Specifications for Lifts with Air Compressors

rfp_requirements.title: Interface directly with OIT registration database for Vehicle Data
Store covert fleet information and mark covert inspections
Display Required Facility, Vehicle, and Control Info on Report
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection report must display Facility Info (name, address, phone, Facility ID, Workstation ID), Vehicle Info (VIN, Plate, Vehicle Type, Make, Model, Odometer, Fuel Type, GVWR), and Control Info (Certificate, Software Version, Date, Year, Time, Inspection Type, Sticker #, Test Fee).

rfp_requirements.title: Include Safety overallSafetyResult and Dual Exhaust Variant
rfp_requirements.description: The XML must include Safety overallSafetyResult (1) and the VehiclePhysicalParmsType Variant of SafetyResultCodeType OR SBUResultCodeType OR CBUResultCodeType DualExhaust.

rfp_requirements.title: Support Variant Safety Result Code Types (SafetyResultCodeType, SBUResultCodeType, CBUResultCodeType)
rfp_requirements.description: The Safety XML must support the VehiclePhysicalParmsType variant accommodating SafetyResultCodeType OR SBUResultCodeType OR CBUResultCodeType for DualExhaust reporting.
